# Manan Mazhar (Mnnan) — Full Stack Developer

> Manan Mazhar, also known as Mnnan (GitHub: @mnnandev), is a Full Stack Developer from Pakistan. He builds Shopify stores, WordPress and WooCommerce websites, OpenCart stores, and MERN stack applications. He leads Starlent Tech (https://starlent.tech), also associated with Tech Titan Studio.
